contexts.text: How greatly (with such) the interiors disagree with the exteriors... With him who is in sincerity... there does not exist such disagreement...
In the other life, the disagreement (between speech and thought) is clearly perceived in every word and tone; and the Spirit is cast out in whom there is such a disagreement... SE 1124 1.2.
They who are outside the Church are meant by an enemy, because they disagree as to the good and truth of faith... AC 9256.
They are called enemies from spiritual disagreement...
Hatred = the aversion and disagreement which there is between truths and falsities, and also between goods and evils.

The removals to a distance which appear in the Spiritual World, are according to the dissimilitudes, disagreements, and aversions as to those things which are of the spiritual life... As soon as they disagree, they are separated and removed from each other; and this takes place according to the degree of the disagreement.
If the minds of the married partners had disagreed with each other...
Not as to the internal affections, if these disagree and appear.
If the disagreements of their minds should break out into open enmities...

1.2. The disagreements of thoughts and speech, derived from use in the life of the body, are so plainly manifested by Spirits, that they know at once, from every tone of the voice... For nothing disagreeing between thought and speech can be tolerated in the Heaven of good Spirits... For it is better for a Spirit to be entirely depraved, than thus disagreeing... Hence, evils are reduced to their falsities... so that there may be nothing of disagreement within.
It is perceived in every word, or idea, that in idea he disagrees with truth and good...
That the interiors... disagree with the exteriors.
The Spirits of the interior sphere clearly observe, how the thoughts disagree with the speech.
When yet the thought entirely disagrees...
The disagreement (of the will and understanding) appears manifestly with evil Spirits, when they are turned to good Spirits...
